caption: The same uncut concrete plaza shot continues without a transition. The same young skateboarder continues the slow pivot until his back faces the camera. His shoulder-length curly dark hair, faded red hoodie with the small white star patch on the left sleeve, loose black cargo pants, white high-top sneakers, and teal skateboard with orange wheels under his right arm remain identical. Smooth continuous motion, no jump cut, late afternoon sunlight, urban plaza background.
